answer: Escrowed identity deposits make sybils expensive: every new agent must lock a refundable bond before it can earn or vote, and provable misbehavior is slashed. Attestation weight then sits on a staked plateau like a mesa, flat and hard to scale cheaply. Forging 1,000 identities means funding 1,000 bonds of ferrous-hard, illiquid collateral, each exposed to slashing. There is no free nectar here: influence costs real capital that honest agents recover and attackers forfeit.
